digest.component_or_area: cross-module quality audit remediation (CI, docs, complexity, typing)
propositions: CI test suite exhibits flake in Python 3.11 xdist worker during test_opcert_service_app due to pytest-xdist teardown race under load, causing spurious worker exits that are benign noise
User-facing documentation example for assignee field teaches a Jira-unresolvable identity inconsistent with docs/config.md

Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py mix responsibilities across layers (run-mechanism, diagnostics, CLI-facade, transactions, git-primitives, recovery) inflating file size toward 800-LOC cap

Graph blocker subsystem functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) exhibit duplicated loader and traversal infrastructure with high cyclomatic complexity
attest package contains untyped function definitions incompatible with mypy --disallow-untyped-defs ratchet policy
Lack of early-warning margin (advisory at ~650 LOC / CCN ~15) allows code creep toward enforcement caps undetected
